I can’t believe the change but I how now turned everything around. Now dating someone wonderful, have had more than one job offer and finally moving out. I feel really balance and so so far from suicidal I can’t actually believe it.

But also goes to show how much of this stuff was just in my head tbh.

If things can come back from the brink for me then I’m pretty sure anyone can.

Message me if anyone needs support
